english.title: Accept clients money without insurance cover
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) accepted the money of a client, namely **(..SPECIFY CLIENT..), in the course of estate agency work, when there were no authorised arrangements in force under which, in the event of your failing to account for such money to the person entitled to it, your liability would be made good by another
english.legislation: Contrary to section 16(1) and (6) of the Estate Agents Act 1979.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit on Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
